title: Desk Reference: Benefits, Recovery and Contributions on Unemployment Insurance Appeals
content:
Four money terms of Unemployment Insurance Appeals — while an appeal is pending and after a favorable decision — are fixed per docket: whether the claimant must keep certifying weekly while the appeal is pending in order to be paid for those weeks if the claimant wins; whether benefits are paid once a decision favors the claimant even if the other party appeals further; whether recovery of the appealed overpayment stops while the appeal is pending; and whether the employer must keep paying contributions at the appealed rate while the appeal is pending, with any reduction credited after a favorable decision.

| Docket | Keep certifying weekly while pending | Pay when due after a favorable decision | Recovery of the appealed overpayment suspended while pending | Contributions payable at the appealed rate while pending |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lower Authority Appeal — Separation Issue | yes | yes | no | no |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Able and Available Issue | yes | yes | no | no |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Monetary Determination | yes | yes | no | no |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Overpayment and Fraud | yes | no | yes | no |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Benefit Charge | no | no | no | no |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Contribution Rate | no | no | no | yes |
| Higher Authority Appeal — Board of Review | yes | yes | no | no |

## Desk answers drawn from the table

- **Weekly certification.** The claimant keeps certifying while an appeal is pending on the Separation Issue, Able and Available Issue, Monetary Determination, Overpayment and Fraud and Board of Review dockets; the two employer dockets carry no such term.
- **Recovery.** Only an appeal on the Overpayment and Fraud docket stops recovery of the appealed overpayment while it is pending.
- **Contributions.** Only an appeal on the Employer Contribution Rate docket leaves the employer paying at the appealed rate while it is pending, with any reduction credited after a favorable decision.
- **Pay when due.** Benefits found payable are paid on issue of a favorable decision, even if the other party appeals further, on the Separation Issue, Able and Available Issue, Monetary Determination and Board of Review dockets.
